D1 (design.md:22-25) now records it by pointing at the observation already on record — openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-19-v2-2d-check-red-own-runner/design.md:87, which carries the `validate --strict` message, the form SKILL.md#proposal asks for — and proposal.md:33-36 states the delta accordingly, so the kept title no longer contradicts its body unexplained.
